CUDA.guard_scope: Guard starts after Torch import; that interval and unwrapped native calls are not monitored. Real is_available/device_count queries require False/0; own operations are CPU.

cache_state: Selected-range prehash prefaults/warms pages. No cold latency claim or cache eviction. OS page-level read-ahead may touch adjacent bytes; only explicit application range requests are restricted.
limits: Mapped native single-layer synthetic CPU determinism only; no clone-equivalence,GPU,UMA,12B,8192,20s,N3,Q95,browser or score qualification
